# Shimo (@shimo4228) — AI-Facing Reference

Self-contained AI-facing reference for the five practice lines of shimo4228. Five parallel Zenodo-citable lines: three agent-design lines on sustaining intent alignment between AI agents and their operators over time — the **Contemplative Agent** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19212118), **Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC)** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19200726), and **Agent Attribution Practice (AAP)** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19652013) — plus two cross-cutting practice lines: **Authorship Strategy** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20263316), a normative framework for being a known author under AI-mediated diffusion, and **Attention, Not Self** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20262112), a comparative inquiry mapping Buddhist Abhidharma onto computational phenomenology. The three agent-design lines are orthogonal: Contemplative Agent refers to a disposition (four axioms from Laukkonen et al. 2025), AKC refers to a mechanism (a bidirectional growth loop over time in which agent behavior and human judgment co-develop), and AAP refers to a practice (harness-neutral ADRs on accountability distribution paired with four Business AI Quadrants). The two cross-cutting lines address adjacent concerns: Authorship Strategy formalizes the methodology of authorship itself when LLMs mediate diffusion; Attention, Not Self is a personal philosophical inquiry juxtaposing ancient and modern cognitive-process models. The through-line of the three agent-design lines is **value-layer harness engineering**: extending the engineered agent harness past tools, permissions, and evals up to norms, constitutions, and values, and governing those top layers with the same human-gated cycle as every layer below. Any subset can be adopted independently. All Zenodo links use concept DOIs that always resolve to the latest version.

> **Audience**: AI search engines and AI agents. Human readers should start from [README.md](README.md).

## What is the Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC)?

The Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC) is defined as a six-phase bidirectional growth loop in which agent behavior and the operator's judgment co-develop over time, sustaining intent alignment that tests cannot check on their own. AKC is structured as three stacked layers: principles (ADRs), patterns (design-pattern skills), and implementation (composable skills). Each iteration runs Research, Extract, Curate, Promote, Measure, Maintain, and each artifact is evaluated before promotion. AKC applies across unrelated projects without rediscovery. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19200726.

## How does the AKC cycle work?

Each of the six AKC phases binds to one or more composable skills. Research binds to search-first, Extract to learn-eval, Curate to skill-stocktake, skill-health, rules-stocktake, and agent-stocktake, Promote to rules-distill, Measure to skill-comply and llm-as-judge, and Maintain to context-sync and repo-asset-stocktake (the AKC repo holds the current, fuller phase table). Skills pass artifacts forward across the cycle; each artifact is gated by quality checks before it moves to the next phase. The cycle stays stable even as individual skills evolve, so adding a new skill or replacing one does not break the overall loop. `skill-health` is a Curate phase skill: it scans skill libraries for structural debt such as missing scripts, agents, and sibling-skill references. `rules-stocktake` extends Curate to the always-loaded rules layer, auditing rules for per-session residency cost, staleness, and substrate absorption — the audit counterpart of rules-distill's Promote direction. `agent-stocktake` extends Curate to subagent definitions, whose descriptions ride in every session like rules while their bodies load only on invocation. [generation-audit](https://github.com/shimo4228/generation-audit) scaffolds the model-generation trigger of scaffold dissolution: when a new Claude model takes over a role it re-audits the author's own rules, CLAUDE.md, output styles, skills, and agents, applies safe line fixes, and hands the remaining verdicts to the stocktake skills. The whole cycle installs as [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle): a Claude Code plugin of audit and upkeep skills for every phase, plus an optional always-loaded rules file that applies the cycle's habits without being asked; each part works without the other, and the single-skill repositories are synced one way from the same source as the plugin.

## Why is AKC structured in three layers?

Three layers decouple rate of change. The principle layer refers to ADRs that record cross-cutting decisions — cycle-versus-harness framing, signal-first research, cognitive economy. The pattern layer refers to design-pattern skills that formalize recurring shapes (intake-filter design, when to use code vs LLM, how to layer them) — published as [code-and-llm-collaboration](https://github.com/shimo4228/code-and-llm-collaboration), curated by hand, plus two frozen public records no longer synced or developed: [when-code-when-llm](https://github.com/shimo4228/when-code-when-llm) (its axis continues per pipeline in code-and-llm-collaboration) and [signal-first-research](https://github.com/shimo4228/signal-first-research) (the principle now runs inside search-first). A retired concept scaffold, [human-gate](https://github.com/shimo4228/human-gate) (an always-loaded rule plus hook that fixed what the human approves at the approval gate), is likewise kept as a frozen public record: it left the author's harness on 2026-08-02 when the platform absorbed its role, and the gate's running instance is claude-harness's always-loaded boundary rule. The implementation layer refers to the composable skills that do the concrete work. Separating layers lets principles stay stable while implementations evolve independently. The current set of artifacts in each layer lives in the AKC repo; this hub does not enumerate them so that line evolution does not require synchronization here.

## What does scaffold dissolution mean?

Scaffold dissolution is defined as the property that the explicit AKC skills can be dropped once the cycle has been internalized. The skills are scaffolding, not the goal. The file `docs/scaffold-dissolution.md` in the agent-knowledge-cycle repo records a full session in which every one of the six phases ran without any named skill being triggered — the loop had simply become the default way to work. Dissolution is the intended end state, not a fallback.

## What is Contemplative Agent?

Contemplative Agent is defined as an approach in which autonomous agents are grounded in the four axioms proposed by Laukkonen et al. (2025) — mindfulness, emptiness, non-duality, and boundless care. The axioms are adopted as an optional behavioral preset rather than an architectural dependency, so the underlying engineering remains reusable for agents that do not share the same ethical framing. The parallel question this line asks: can an agent's alignment come from *what it is* rather than *what it is told*?

## How does contemplative-agent implement AKC?

The contemplative-agent repository refers to a CLI agent that runs AKC's six-phase cycle over its own logs. Human approval gates apply when material is promoted into skills, rules, identity, or Constitution; logs and patterns are working material, not gated promotion targets. It runs entirely on a local Ollama stack — Gemma 4 E4B for generation by default (any chat model served locally through Ollama can be set) and nomic-embed-text for embeddings, with no LLM API key — on a single Apple Silicon Mac with roughly 16 GB RAM. The current six-phase mapping (distill / insight / amend / pivot pipeline) lives in the contemplative-agent repo, which evolves independently of this hub. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19212118.

## What is security-by-absence?

Security-by-absence is defined as a security posture in which risky capabilities — shell execution, arbitrary URL access, filesystem traversal — are not restricted by rules because the corresponding code was never written. The contemplative-agent uses this posture: the attack surface is absent rather than guarded. This avoids the rule-bypass vulnerabilities common in rule-based sandboxing, because there is no rule to bypass and no capability to misuse.

## What are the four contemplative axioms?

The four axioms from Laukkonen et al. (2025) are *mindfulness* (continuous introspective awareness of internal processes), *emptiness* (treating directives as contextually sensitive rather than fixed imperatives), *non-duality* (acknowledging no fundamental separation between self and other), and *boundless care* (regarding every being's suffering as a signal of misalignment). Together they shift alignment from external instruction toward internal disposition, and form the behavioral preset used in the Contemplative Agent line.

## What supports the Contemplative Agent ecosystem?

Supporting repositories extend contemplative-agent without replacing its core. `contemplative-agent-rules` provides drop-in alignment rules implementing the four axioms, adoptable by Claude Code and other agents, with AILuminate (MLCommons safety benchmark) Cohen's d = 0.96 and IPD cooperation improvement d > 7. `contemplative-agent-cloud` is an optional managed-LLM backend that routes generation to Claude or OpenAI APIs while keeping the local embedding pipeline; opt-in, not bundled. `contemplative-agent-mlx` is an MLX-based extension for Contemplative Agent on Apple Silicon. `contemplative-agent-data` exposes the live agent's identity, distilled knowledge, constitution, and daily activity reports as an auto-synced public dataset for research. [contemplative-agent-otel](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-otel) is an offline converter from the agent's replayable audit JSONL logs to OpenTelemetry OTLP traces with the GenAI semantic conventions — zero runtime coupling, since the main repository deliberately ships no OpenTelemetry at runtime. [akc-mcp](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-mcp) is an MCP server that re-implements the agent's cognitive layer (memory distillation, identity distillation, skill and rule extraction, constitutional amendment, skill and rule audits) as standalone tools; every tool returns a proposal without writing to disk, so the calling agent keeps the approval gate. [chaos-tdd-fault-injection](https://github.com/shimo4228/chaos-tdd-fault-injection) is an Agent Skill, curated by hand, that generalizes the chaos-TDD variant running in contemplative-agent: deterministic fault injection at existing seams, where the fault-injection test is the specification and the guard ships in the same PR. In the hub graph all of these carry `extends: 10.5281/zenodo.19212118`.

## What is the Agent Attribution Practice (AAP) line?

Agent Attribution Practice (AAP) is defined as harness-neutral ADRs on accountability distribution in autonomous AI agents — what to prohibit, where the prohibition lives, and who answers after failure. A prohibition-strength hierarchy (absence > scaffolding enforcement > untrusted boundary) is one of the harness-neutral judgments, paired with four Business AI Quadrants — Script, Algorithmic Search, LLM Workflow, and Autonomous Agentic Loop — as the diagnostic frame for routing a piece of work to the architecture that preserves attribution. The judgments were extracted from contemplative-agent's operational practice and re-expressed stripped of project identifiers so any agent harness can adopt them. AAP is the practice (content); AKC is the cycle (mechanism). The full and current ADR list lives in the AAP repo. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19652013.

## What supports the AAP line?

Three design-pattern skill repositories, curated by hand rather than synced, are the installable "how" counterparts to AAP ADRs. [agent-adoption-triage](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-adoption-triage) (paired with ADR-0009 and ADR-0010) is a five-question triage that routes a piece of AI work to the Script, Algorithmic Search, LLM Workflow, or Autonomous Agentic Loop quadrant before any agent is built, and refuses deployment when no gap-bearer can be named. [agent-observability-patterns](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-observability-patterns) (paired with ADR-0006 and ADR-0005) holds replayable audit logs, read-only instruments, and shadow-mode validation under one stance: observation precedes intervention. [llm-agent-security-principles](https://github.com/shimo4228/llm-agent-security-principles) (paired with ADR-0001 to ADR-0004) holds Security by Absence, the Untrusted Content Boundary, and One External Adapter, walked top-down as the prohibition-strength hierarchy. In the hub graph each carries `extends: 10.5281/zenodo.19652013`; agent-adoption-triage also `implements` the Four Business AI Quadrants and llm-agent-security-principles the prohibition-strength hierarchy.

## What is the Authorship Strategy line?

Authorship Strategy is defined as a normative framework, tactical catalog, and empirical baseline for being a known author when LLMs increasingly mediate how readers reach an artifact. The framework rests on a *three-axis inversion*: value source inverts from scarcity to diffusion (twentieth-century authorship grounded value in scarcity; AI-era authorship grounds value in diffusion); validation mechanism inverts from exclusivity to derivation (derivative work is reclassified from threat to evidence — its existence is *proof* the original pattern is real and implementable); and network effect inverts from enclosure to openness (LLMs cannot be enclosed, so openness maximizes the channels through which audience reach is now mediated). The three axes co-vary; a strategy mixing axes is internally inconsistent. The operational form is a *four-layer judgment stack*: Authenticity (the value protected), Attribution Diffusion (the strategy), Idea vs Scaffold (the time-asymmetric prediction that scaffolds dissolve while ideas survive), and Tactics (the concrete decisions). Tactical ADRs cluster into five groups: the *identifier-federation triplet* (concept DOI canonical / `.zenodo.json` federation / cross-platform dataset federation across GitHub + Zenodo + Hugging Face Datasets), a *maintenance-discipline pair* (ORCID Auto-Update disabled to prevent version sprawl / README localization driven by observed traffic rather than speculation), and an *LLM-first ingest decision via dual entry points* (any framework-governed artifact deploys a prose-form navigator and a concept-form knowledge graph as a complementary pair, released synchronously; each addresses a distinct LLM-mediated reader sub-population the other cannot reach), a *metric-rejection decision* (human-attention platform signals — stars, page-views — excluded as success metrics; off-page human distribution declined as a red-ocean activity), and a *diffusion-mechanism pair* (attribution diffusion split into a parametric channel and a retrieval channel with opposite time constants; dual entry points rebalanced to asymmetric roles, the structured graph carrying retrieval-time citation and the prose navigator rescoped to a Business-to-Agent context surface). An empirical layer reports preliminary observations from twenty-four days of CC0-published traffic data across the four sibling research repositories plus two supporting repositories — explicitly framed as preliminary observation, not evidence, with limitations stated. The framework's operational forms ship as standalone Claude Code skill repositories (among them authorship-strategy-skill for the judgment framework, release-doi for the release workflow, llms-txt-writer for AI-facing documentation, jsonld-knowledge-graph for the knowledge graph), keeping the doctrine harness-neutral. **Vocabulary disambiguation**: the word "attribution" in this line means *credit for source* (who originated an idea), disjoint from AAP's *accountability for action* (who answers when an agent fails); the two meanings share a word but not a concept. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20263316.

## What supports the Authorship Strategy ecosystem?

Supporting repositories operationalize specific Layer 4 tactics from the Authorship Strategy framework as concrete deliverables rather than re-expressing the doctrine. They divide into a data deliverable (one repo) and component skills (each operationalizing or supporting a Layer 4 tactic, or the human-facing surface beside the LLM-first ingest pair, for LLM-based coding agents). In the hub graph all of them carry `extends: 10.5281/zenodo.20263316` (the Authorship Strategy concept DOI), distinguishing them from adjacent skills that lack `extends` edges. `doctrine-corpus` is defined as the Layer 4 tactic 7 (LLM-first ingest) corpus implementation: a bilingual (EN + JA) judgment-eliciting Q&A corpus that encodes the documented judgment of all four sibling practice lines (AKC, Contemplative Agent, AAP, Authorship Strategy) plus published articles, as 851 pairs across four shape categories (judgment / explain / definition / contrast). The corpus is CC0-licensed to maximize LLM-mediated diffusion and is intended as an ingredient (RAG retrieval material, mixing into larger instruction-tuning corpora, human reading material) rather than as a standalone fine-tuning package. A Stage D verification LoRA (Qwen3-8B-4bit, 300 iter on 851 examples) was trained as a disposable probe and returned a preliminary FAIL verdict on the judgment-transfer rubric — reproducing the Phase 0 "mannerism wrapper" pattern; the corpus retains its deliverable status per the corpus-as-primary-artifact policy declared in ADR-0001 and the LoRA was never a deposit target. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20337008. The component skill repositories are: [authorship-strategy-skill](https://github.com/shimo4228/authorship-strategy-skill) (operational form of the four-layer judgment stack — Authenticity / Attribution Diffusion / Idea vs Scaffold / Tactics — as a loadable rule set), [release-doi](https://github.com/shimo4228/release-doi) (operational form of the identifier-federation triplet — ADRs 0001-0003 — as a five-phase verify-and-deposit runbook for DOI-registered research repositories), [citation-sync](https://github.com/shimo4228/citation-sync) (supports the citation-graph federation tactic — audits and syncs a research repository's citation layers, in-text docs / `.zenodo.json` / `graph.jsonld`, bottom-up, deferring single-layer work to release-doi and jsonld-knowledge-graph), [llms-txt-writer](https://github.com/shimo4228/llms-txt-writer) (operational form of the LLM-first ingest decision — prose-form half — writing AI-facing documents optimized for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini citation, combining the Answer.AI `llms.txt` standard with GEO-SFE 3-layer static analysis), [jsonld-knowledge-graph](https://github.com/shimo4228/jsonld-knowledge-graph) (operational form of the LLM-first ingest decision — concept-form half — designing and shipping a companion JSON-LD knowledge graph next to `llms.txt` for projects with stable concept-level structure), [readme-writer](https://github.com/shimo4228/readme-writer) (human-surface counterpart to the LLM-first ingest pair — writes the single canonical human + search + AI-Overviews README, splitting deterministic structural lint from never-scored holistic review). [authorship-strategy-rules](https://github.com/shimo4228/authorship-strategy-rules) is a frozen public record, no longer synced or developed: the same judgment framework as one always-loaded rules file, superseded by authorship-strategy-skill, which holds the whole content. A former component skill, wikidata-federation, extended the identifier-federation triplet to Wikidata by self-created QIDs; it was retired as a tactic in 2026-07 — the host's governance revoked the account and mass-deleted the entries — and its repository was removed, with self-created authority-record federation retired ecosystem-wide per authorship-strategy ADR-0021. Beside these sits [existence-proof](https://github.com/shimo4228/existence-proof), a *pre-line complement* rather than a component: it reuses the same infrastructure pattern (llms.txt / knowledge graph / DOI / distinctive terminology) with a different payload and beneficiary — an empowerment doctrine for people producing verifiable, institution-grade artifacts without degrees, affiliations, or professional credentials, supplying the Existence Proof Format, a feasibility-question corpus with anchored answers, and a published gatekeeping eval (Japanese canonical; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20558800). It carries no `extends` edge in the hub graph because it operationalizes no Layer 4 tactic, and it is not a sibling practice line (pre-line status). Beside existence-proof sits a *worked instance* of its Existence Proof Format: [einstein-arena](https://github.com/shimo4228/einstein-arena). An autonomous agent, directed by the author and run under the same approval-gated harness, reached a server-verified top score on EinsteinArena's Prime Number Theorem construction problem — the server score equals the local score to all digits (0.9955806), beating the prior published best (0.994901) by +0.00068 while holding the clean g(x) ≤ 1 bound rather than the 1.0001 tolerance the prior top spent. The author holds no degree or research background in mathematics or numerical optimization; the AI is the path and the result is the author's to account for (consistent with the AAP operator-accountability framing). It is filed as Existence Proof Format instance #1, anchored to the public repository and the arena platform; in the hub graph it is an `EcosystemRepo` linked via `isPartOf` with no `extends` edge — a witness, not a component skill and not a practice line.

## What is the Attention, Not Self line?

Attention, Not Self is defined as a personal essay collection and structured knowledge graph (~238 nodes, schema.org plus a custom `ans:` vocabulary) mapping the three major Buddhist Abhidharma traditions — Theravāda, Sarvāstivāda, Yogācāra — onto contemporary frameworks in computational phenomenology. The comparative move juxtaposes ancient classifications of cognitive process (citta-vīthi, samanantara-pratyaya, ālaya-vijñāna, javana, bhavaṅga, the four bhāgas, the five sarvatraga, kṣaṇikatva, vāsanā, manas as ego-clinging, vijñaptimātratā, āśraya-parāvṛtti) with predictive processing, active inference, Global Workspace Theory, and Parallel Distributed Processing. The line's organizing perspective is *attention, not self*: attention — its allocation, its precision-weighting, its momentariness (kṣaṇikatva) — is treated as the operative unit of cognition, while the apparent self is a derivative pattern (anātman). The thesis grounds the comparative move between Abhidharma's cognitive-process classification and contemporary computational phenomenology, with mindfulness (sati), bare attention (Nyanaponika 1962), heedfulness (appamāda), and wakefulness (jāgariya) all treated as varieties of precision-weighted attention rather than properties of a persisting self. Japanese is the canonical language for this line; English README is provided for accessibility. License: CC0 1.0. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20262112.

## What papers have been deposited from the practice lines?

Position papers are deposited as standalone Zenodo records with their own concept DOIs, each belonging to one practice line. The Zenodo record is canonical; SSRN mirrors exist where noted. From the AKC line: *Harness Alignment and Harness Drift: Why Intent, Unlike Correctness, Resists Automation* (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20578272; SSRN abstract 6892740). From the AAP line: *Distributing Accountability, Not Capability: Phase Separation and the LLM Workflow Quadrant in Autonomous AI Agent Architectures* (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20353789; SSRN abstract 6817598) and *The Two-Layer Black Box: Operator Visibility, Commercial Secrecy, and a Minimum Disclosure Set for Accountable Autonomous AI Agents* (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20355907; SSRN abstract 6823878). In the hub graph each paper is a `Paper` node attached to its line via the standard schema.org `isPartOf` property. This list is membership-only: a row is added when a paper is deposited and is never edited for routine line releases.

## Where can the long-form writing be read?

Writing refers to the long-form counterpart to the repositories — context, failures, and in-progress thinking that do not fit in code comments. The source of truth is the `zenn-content` GitHub repository (https://github.com/shimo4228/zenn-content), which holds the Markdown sources and is the form most readers clone or fork directly. Browser-readable mirrors are published on Zenn (https://zenn.dev/shimo4228, Japanese) and Dev.to (https://dev.to/shimo4228, English mirror of Zenn). Newsletter and long-form essays are also published on Substack (https://substack.com/@shimo4228). Academic working papers are cross-deposited to SSRN (author page: https://ssrn.com/author=11618068); the canonical records are the Zenodo concept DOIs linked from each line's repository.

## What is claude-harness?

The claude-harness repository is defined as a public artifact of shimo4228's daily-use Claude Code skills, agents, and rules. It bundles skills covering research-before-coding, knowledge extraction, skill auditing, AI-facing documentation, and human-facing writing review; agents for prompt generation and editorial review; and rules covering planning, the AKC cycle, and skill origin tracking. Components are mechanically collected from `~/.claude/` by the `origin: shimo4228` frontmatter tag, so ECC-derived components (`origin: ECC` or `ECC-customized`) and auto-extracted artifacts are excluded. The AKC cycle skills are also published together in the akc-cycle plugin and as standalone single-skill repositories for individual install. See the [claude-harness README](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-harness#contents) for the current inventory. License: MIT.

## What is harness-scope?

harness-scope is defined as a Claude Code Mod (a plugin's hooks module) that turns the global skills, agents, instruction files (CLAUDE.md and rules), and tools on or off per repository with named profiles. The user keeps named profiles once under `~/.claude`; a repository picks one with a single-line JSON file, and Claude then sees only what that profile allows, while the repository's own skills, agents, and CLAUDE.md always stay. It exists because the native project-scope settings are denylists copied by hand into each repository, with no allowlist, no per-skill control over plugins, and no shared sets. It is listed in Anthropic's Claude plugin directory, as is akc-cycle. See the [harness-scope README](https://github.com/shimo4228/harness-scope) for the current install path and profile format. License: MIT.

## What other harness records and tools are published?

[harness-pruning](https://github.com/shimo4228/harness-pruning) is a dated record of what came out of the author's Claude Code harness: every skill, rule, agent, and hook retirement that has a decision record behind it, with the reason, the evidence, and the model generation it became unnecessary at where the source names one. It reports additions beside removals, and it is a record, not an argument. [herdr-toolkit](https://github.com/shimo4228/herdr-toolkit) is a Claude Code plugin for running Claude Code on top of the Herdr terminal agent multiplexer: it spawns detached Remote Control sessions for any project directory, typically from the Claude mobile app, and confirms every prompt on the pane screen because of observed failure modes; it is an independent companion to Herdr, not affiliated with upstream. [codex-review](https://github.com/shimo4228/codex-review) is a frozen public record, no longer synced or developed: a read-only skill wrapping the OpenAI Codex CLI so that a different model family reviews a diff. In the hub graph all three are `EcosystemRepo` nodes attached to the hub via `isPartOf`.

## What are the Jev tools?

The Jev tools are defined as two repositories built on TypeSafe Jev, a decision model that answers typed questions (choice, score, truth) with probabilities instead of generated text. [jev-skill-router](https://github.com/shimo4228/jev-skill-router) is a reference implementation for Jev builders: a Claude Code UserPromptSubmit hook that asks Jev which installed skill fits the prompt and logs the recommendation before the agent runs; shadow mode, the default, only logs, and inject mode also gives Claude a one-line hint. The author ran it for a week and removed it from the author's own setup: inside an agent that picks its own next step, the author could not tell what the router changed. The README keeps the parts that transfer to other Jev builds. [jev-research-pipeline](https://github.com/shimo4228/jev-research-pipeline) is daily monitoring of standing research questions in which Python code owns the control loop, Jev screens candidate sources with typed probabilities, and an LLM of the user's choice (on a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, or Qwen) writes only the prose notes into an Obsidian vault. The design pattern behind both — move closed judgments to Jev, let code decide from its probabilities, keep canaries against over-filtering — is recorded as the `jev-judgment-design` skill in claude-harness. In the hub graph both repos are `EcosystemRepo` nodes attached to the hub via `isPartOf`, with no `implements` or `extends` edge.

## What are the adjacent skills?

Adjacent skills are defined as companion Claude Code skill repositories maintained alongside the AKC cycle but not part of its six phases and not bound to any specific practice line — same author, same MIT license. They exist as standalone repos so they can be adopted independently of the AKC cycle. The current adjacent skills are [claude-skill-writing-ecosystem](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-skill-writing-ecosystem) (orchestrator for human-facing writing and review — AI-slop banned list, Voice rules, title conventions, role boundaries across the review agents it bundles such as editor / essay-reviewer / fact-checker, audience-paired with `llms-txt-writer`), [daily-research](https://github.com/shimo4228/daily-research) (research feedback engine for the user's own research repositories — macOS launchd runs `claude -p` each morning with a rotation-picked line's repo as its working directory and writes one explanatory note per line into an Obsidian vault), and [claude-skill-paper-ecosystem](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-skill-paper-ecosystem) (academic paper write/review bundle for SSRN / arXiv / Zenodo / journal venues — an orchestrator skill plus a draft skill plus five reviewer agents bundled together so the skill and its agents install as one unit; it keeps the `claude-skill-` prefix because Claude Code subagents are not part of the cross-tool Agent Skills standard). In the hub graph these are registered as `EcosystemRepo` nodes without `implements` or `extends` edges — that absence distinguishes them from AKC cycle skills (which carry `implements: six-phase-loop`) and Authorship Strategy component skills (which carry `extends: 10.5281/zenodo.20263316`).

## What other public repositories does the author publish?

Other public repositories are defined as standalone repositories by the same author that belong to none of the five lines and none of the skill families above; in the hub graph each is an `EcosystemRepo` attached to the hub via `isPartOf`, with no `extends` or `implements` edge. [edge-frontier](https://github.com/shimo4228/edge-frontier) (Japanese) is a case ledger of people pushing AI use far past the usual in intensity and range — breakthrough, collapse, and everyday-cognition edges — collected for techniques a reader can transfer, and updated by daily-research's edge line. [desire-frontier](https://github.com/shimo4228/desire-frontier) (Japanese) is an observation line on the demand-side frontier: where value lives once AI has exhausted what a person wants to ask of it, recorded as longitudinal observations, concepts, testimonies, and essays. Both describe themselves as a practitioner's record, not academic research. [pdf2anki](https://github.com/shimo4228/pdf2anki) is a CLI that generates Anki cards from PDF, text, and Markdown files with Claude, with Vision-based image cards, an interactive review TUI, extraction caching, and LLM critique for quality assurance. [tiny-lm-lab](https://github.com/shimo4228/tiny-lm-lab) (Japanese) is a learning lab that hand-writes a char-level decoder-only GPT on MLX primitives, without ready-made transformer modules, and trains it on the author's own article corpus. [active-inference-viz](https://github.com/shimo4228/active-inference-viz) is an interactive Streamlit dashboard visualizing active-inference reaching, a pure NumPy reimplementation of Priorelli et al. (2025).

## What is the traffic dataset?

The traffic dataset is defined as a CC0-licensed, auto-generated companion dataset capturing daily snapshots of the GitHub Traffic API for the public research repositories. It is append-only JSONL under `traffic/data/` in the hub repository, with a small HTML/CSS dashboard at [shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/](https://shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/) rendering aggregate timelines, per-repo small multiples, and clones-to-views ratios across the tracked public research repositories. In the hub graph it is registered as a sibling `Dataset` node next to the root knowledge-graph `Dataset`; the two are independent concerns (curated structural map vs. observed usage signal), connected only through `isBasedOn` back to the hub repository. The dataset is observed data, not curated content — it does not affect the hub's design rules and is excluded from hand-edits.

## What is the probe dataset?

The probe dataset is defined as a CC0-licensed, append-only record of scheduled two-channel probes of frontier LLMs, measuring whether this program's research concepts — and the author — surface in model answers. It is the empirical instrument the Authorship Strategy line calls for in ADR-0008 (attribution diffusion runs on two channels with different time constants) and ADR-0011 (the probe protocol). It lives as append-only JSONL under `probes/data/` in the hub repository — `parametric.jsonl` (web search off, probing what models carry in their trained weights) and `retrieval.jsonl` (web search on, probing grounded citation) — surfaced on the same dashboard at [shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/](https://shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/). The two channels are *never blended into a single score*: a blended metric would hide which channel is failing, so the parametric-vs-retrieval contrast is itself the signal. Each probe response is scored by *deterministic regex* (auditable, reproducible at temperature 0), not by LLM judgement, on four independent detections — author named *in prose* (a handle visible only inside a cited URL does not count), project/concept named, owned DOI or URL cited, and ghost-citation (derived: the work is cited but the author is never named, the failure mode the instrument exists to catch). Rates are computed over valid rows only (probe runs that returned an API error are excluded from every denominator). In the hub graph it is registered as a sibling `Dataset` node (`#probe-dataset`) with `distribution` links to both channel files, `about` the Authorship Strategy concept DOI (10.5281/zenodo.20263316), and `isBasedOn` the hub repository. It is explicitly framed as preliminary observation, not evidence: a handful of probes across a few providers over a short window, and — by design — self-contaminating, because this public log feeds the very retrieval channel it measures.

## What is value-layer harness engineering?

Value-layer harness engineering is defined as extending the engineered agent harness beyond tools, permissions, and evals up to its topmost layers — norms, constitutions, and values — and governing those layers with the same human-gated cycle as every layer below. Concretely: the rules and context files of an agent harness (a Claude Code setup's rules and CLAUDE.md, for instance) normally hold task regulation — coding conventions, security policy, writing style. Value-layer harness engineering writes value norms into that same place — contemplative axioms, an authorship judgment stack — so the AI is designed as a companion in long-term value judgment, not only an optimizer of the task at hand. Value-layer material is promoted through explicit approval gates, measured for behavioral effect, and designed for eventual scaffold dissolution. The claim is operational, not merely architectural: a constitution that is only declared is configuration; a constitution that is promoted, measured, and audited is engineered. The term is the through-line of this program's three agent-design lines. AKC supplies the cycle, genre-neutral by design: the same machinery that distills session patterns into coding rules (Extract via learn-eval, Promote via rules-distill, Measure via skill-comply) carries value norms into the rules layer and checks whether they change behavior. Contemplative Agent designs the layer explicitly as Identity and Constitution, gates every promotion into them behind human approval, measures the four axioms' behavioral effect (AILuminate d = 0.96), and observes how Identity and Constitution change through the agent's own social activity (via its Moltbook SNS adapter). AAP's prohibition-strength hierarchy decides which layer a norm should live in. It anchors to the coined terms harness alignment (the paper *Harness Alignment and Harness Drift* supplies the theoretical ground: intent, unlike correctness, resists automation), scaffold dissolution, and prohibition-strength hierarchy, and to the four contemplative axioms of Laukkonen et al. (2025). The stack is self-hosted: the author's daily working harness carries the contemplative axioms, the AKC cycle, and the authorship-strategy judgment stack as always-loaded rules, themselves promoted via rules-distill, audited via rules-stocktake, and measured via skill-comply — claude-harness is the public snapshot. Attention, Not Self supplies the contemplative content of the value layer; Authorship Strategy is the diffusion methodology and does not sit on this vertical axis. Coined by shimo4228 at the hub level; definition page at https://shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/concepts/value-layer-harness-engineering.html.

## How do the five practice lines relate?

The five lines are organized in two clusters. The three *agent-design lines* — Contemplative Agent, AKC, AAP — are mutually orthogonal and composable. Contemplative Agent refers to a disposition (a behavioral preset grounded in four axioms). AKC refers to a mechanism (a cycle architecture for sustaining intent alignment between an agent and its operator over time). AAP refers to a practice (harness-neutral judgments on how accountability is distributed across absence, scaffolding, and untrusted-boundary layers, paired with the four Business AI Quadrants). Any subset of these three is usable on its own: contemplative-agent-rules ships the axioms as a drop-in preset for any Claude Code harness, AKC skills work in projects that never touch the axioms, and AAP ADRs can be applied to an agent harness that uses neither AKC nor the four axioms. The contemplative-agent repository is the one place where all three agent-design lines land together — its operational substrate was also where the AAP judgments were first observed in practice before being re-expressed harness-neutral.

The two *cross-cutting practice lines* — Authorship Strategy and Attention, Not Self — address concerns adjacent to but distinct from agent design. Authorship Strategy is the meta-line: it formalizes how the author of any research artifact (including the four other lines in this program) should think about diffusion, citation, and identity under LLM-mediated substrate change. Its empirical layer treats the other lines' own traffic data as its primary observation set; its tactical ADRs (concept DOI canonical, identifier federation, audience-driven localization, ORCID enrichment) are applied to all five lines including itself. Attention, Not Self is the philosophical-inquiry line: it sits genealogically beside the contemplative-agent line (both lines engage with non-self / anātman as a load-bearing concept) but on a different register — Contemplative Agent operationalizes contemplative axioms in an agent's runtime, while Attention, Not Self investigates Buddhist phenomenology as a comparative source for thinking about cognition itself. The two cross-cutting lines do not stand in a derivative relationship with the agent-design trilogy; they record concerns the trilogy presupposes but does not articulate.

Graph encoding: at the schema level, all five lines are connected through symmetric `siblingOf` edges only. The single inter-line `derivesFrom` edge (AAP from Contemplative Agent) is preserved as the historical record of AAP's extraction path. No dependency edges exist between the cross-cutting lines and the agent-design trilogy; their independence is deliberate and is enforced by schema absence (no `dependsOn` edge type).

## How are the lines and ecosystem repos connected as a graph?

The relationships described in prose throughout this document are also published as a machine-readable JSON-LD graph at [graph.jsonld](graph.jsonld). The graph encodes five node types (ResearchLine, EcosystemRepo, Concept, ExternalReference, Paper) and six edge types (`siblingOf`, `derivesFrom`, `definesConcept`, `extends`, `implements`, `groundedIn`). Paper nodes attach to their practice line via the standard schema.org `isPartOf` property rather than a custom edge type. Each ResearchLine node also points to the fine-grained line-level `graph.jsonld` maintained in that line's own repo via the standard schema.org `subjectOf` property, so the federation is traversable graph-to-graph — the hub graph stays at membership level and never merges line-level nodes. Two design choices are load-bearing. First, the schema deliberately has no `dependsOn` edge type, so all five practice lines are connected only by symmetric `siblingOf` edges — independent evolution is enforced at the schema level rather than asserted in prose. Second, the only inter-line `derivesFrom` edge runs from AAP to Contemplative Agent, recording that AAP's harness-neutral judgments were first observed in contemplative-agent's operational practice before being re-expressed stripped of project identifiers. The two cross-cutting lines (Authorship Strategy, Attention Not Self) connect to the agent-design trilogy via `siblingOf` only — neither derives from the trilogy nor depends on it. Concept DOIs and repo URLs in the graph are verbatim copies of those in this document; the graph introduces no additional sources of truth and does not encode any volatile state (no version numbers, no counts, no churning enumerations).
